sources.title: Magistral — release announcement
sources.evidence: The June 10, 2025 announcement identifies Magistral Small as the 24B open-weight reasoning variant, provides the exact Magistral-Small-2506 repository link, and states Apache 2.0 self-deployment licensing.

sources.title: Magistral Small 1.0 — pinned model card
sources.evidence: Exact June checkpoint: 24B parameters, reasoning traces trained through SFT and RL, Apache 2.0. It describes nominal 128k context but warns performance may degrade beyond 40k and recommends a 40k maximum. Its serving command enables native Mistral tool calling.

sources.title: Magistral Small 1.0 — exact model reference and Weights table
sources.evidence: Exact API ID magistral-small-2506 and release date June 10, 2025. The delivered React HTML payload separately labels Parameters (B)=24 and Active (B)=24 in the row linking Magistral-Small-2506. It advertises 40k context, function calling, and API retirement November 30, 2025.

sources.title: Magistral Small 2506 — pinned Transformers configuration
sources.evidence: MistralForCausalLM, 40 decoder layers, hidden size 5120, intermediate size 32768, 32 query heads and 8 KV heads, vocabulary 131072, BF16, no sliding window, and max_position_embeddings=40960. No vision component or expert configuration is present.

sources.title: Magistral Small 2506 — pinned native configuration
sources.evidence: Native Mistral configuration confirms dense decoder dimensions and the exact max_position_embeddings value of 40960, matching Transformers configuration.

sources.title: Magistral Small 2506 — pinned checkpoint tensor index
sources.evidence: Complete index contains 363 weight tensors over 10 Transformers shards. Each of 40 layers has attention projections and one gate/up/down MLP; the rest are norms, token embeddings and language head. No expert routers or vision weights occur. No storage-byte sum is promoted to an exact parameter count.

sources.title: Magistral Small 1.0 — official Markdown reference
sources.evidence: Explicitly identifies text input, reasoning and text output, function calling, 40k context, Apache 2.0 and exact June 2506 API revision. It records October 31, 2025 deprecation and November 30, 2025 retirement.

sources.title: Official checkpoint repository metadata
sources.evidence: Current official repository is public and ungated at revision ad2fce5b4113139e1877dcadfd826c9262ad8e8c. Its files include the native and sharded safetensors weights and matching configuration files.

sources.title: Official checkpoint shard — bounded download probe
sources.evidence: An unauthenticated Range bytes=0-7 request returned HTTP 206 with Content-Range bytes 0-7/4781571736. Read exactly eight bytes; safetensors header length is 3728. Confirms public weight retrieval without downloading a full shard.

sources.title: Magistral — technical report
sources.evidence: The original Mistral paper identifies the released Small checkpoint as 24B under Apache 2.0 and explains its SFT from Magistral Medium traces followed by RL. Its discussion of multimodal experiments does not override the released checkpoint architecture or exact API modality specification.

name.note: Use the developer versioned name to distinguish June 2025 from later 1.1 and 1.2 revisions.

developer.note: Mistral AI is the named release author and checkpoint publisher; retain the normalized catalog label.

family.note: Exact model belongs to the Magistral reasoning family.

release_date.note: Explicit public launch date and exact revision documentation agree; the technical paper was posted two days later.

open_weights.note: Developer publishes the checkpoint for self-deployment, and an unauthenticated bounded weight request succeeded.

license.note: Named license is explicit in the launch, card metadata/body and exact Weights row; normalize spelling.

parameters_b.note: Nominal whole-model count in billions directly reported by Mistral, not an exact tensor-derived learned-weight total.

active_parameters_b.note: Exact checkpoint row explicitly states Active (B)=24. This is direct nominal disclosure, not an inference from dense architecture.

architecture.note: Configuration and full tensor index establish a dense decoder-only Transformer with grouped-query attention and single MLP projections per layer.

context_window.note: Use the configured 40960-token maximum, matching the official 40k documentation and card recommendation. The card also mentions 128k nominal capacity but warns quality may degrade beyond 40k; do not present 131072 as the unqualified supported setting.

modalities.note: Exact model reference lists text input and reasoning/text output; reasoning traces remain text. Released configuration and complete tensor index contain no vision encoder. Multimodal research experiments are not transferred to this checkpoint.

reasoning.note: Explicit reasoning model trained with SFT and RL; model card documents generated think-delimited reasoning traces before the answer.

tool_call.note: Exact model reference explicitly lists function calling and the pinned card enables the Mistral tool parser and automatic tool choice.

description.value: Text reasoning model based on Mistral Small 3.1, trained with supervised reasoning traces and reinforcement learning.
description.note: Factual training and model-type description; removes the unsupported implication that generated reasoning is a faithful explanation of internal computation.

sources.label: Magistral Small 1.0 — exact model reference and Weights table
Magistral Small 2506 — pinned checkpoint tensor index

patch.notes: Mistral explicitly reports nominal 24B total and 24B active parameters. The released configurations specify 40,960 positions, matching the official 40k reference and model-card recommendation; the card mentions 128k nominal capacity but warns of quality degradation beyond 40k. Text-only released checkpoint with reasoning traces and native function calling. Mistral documents API retirement on November 30, 2025; public weights remain downloadable.

summary: Audited all 14 fields of exact Magistral Small 2506. Adds nominal 24B total and directly documented 24B active parameters plus dense architecture; uses the versioned 1.0 name and normalized Apache-2.0 license. Corrects unqualified 131072 context to the configured/recommended 40960, retaining the card’s 128k caveat. Confirms June 10 release, public downloadable weights, text modalities, reasoning and tools. Replaces promotional description and catalog-only release provenance with primary evidence.
